nodes.rationale: name CharField(255) unique case-sensitive overrides definition['name']; product_type inferred from definition.productType default single_canvas; version bumped per write; imported_at/imported_by co-validated in clean(). nodes.label: Design: error handling table
nodes.rationale: 404 on DoesNotExist; 500 without internal detail; cache failures log and never fail the request; path guard 400 before DB/S3; S3 mask errors 502; calendar asset S3 miss falls back to local; missing prod_layouts.json → warn and succeed with zero rows.

nodes.label: Property 1: cache invalidation completeness
nodes.rationale: Invalidation always attempted after a write even if the write raised; list caches deleted even when the detail pattern delete fails. Validates Req 7.1, 7.5, 7.6.

nodes.label: Property 2: rename atomicity
nodes.rationale: select_for_update on the old row inside transaction.atomic so no request observes old and new both non-deprecated. Validates Req 6.7, 6.8.

nodes.label: Property 3: migration idempotency
nodes.rationale: update_or_create(name=...) so applying 0016 twice leaves the same row set. Validates Req 2.2, 11.1.

nodes.label: Property 4: STORAGE_BACKEND=local full bypass
nodes.rationale: Claims that with STORAGE_BACKEND=local no LayoutCatalogue query is issued and reads fall through to the filesystem. CLAUDE.md ('Views query LayoutCatalogue first; no fallback to disk') and the runbook ('fallback to filesystem not implemented') contradict this — the property was designed but not shipped.

nodes.label: Property 5: mask copy-before-delete
nodes.rationale: Never delete a mask key before a successful copy; copy failure → 500 with original untouched; delete failure after copy → orphan logged, 200.

nodes.label: Property 6: JSON round-trip fidelity
nodes.rationale: JSONField preserves Unicode, nesting and floats; definition_in == definition_out.
